id: title:dmarchuk:copy customer io email images into the media library on import

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a workflow contract, image budget tracker, and Customer.io-specific image rehosting implementation to campaign import, potentially preserving email rendering and preventing account closure issues by storing images in PostHog's media library.

observations.behavior: Adds a new workflow contract class and an image budget tracker, and imports the rehosting service.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a deadline and remaining image count to the workflow import request, allowing the system to drop requests from slow hosts or enforce a shared image budget.

observations.behavior: Adds the rehosting service to the workflow import facade and its exported symbols.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the image rehosting service available to the workflow import facade, suggesting it is called during campaign import.

observations.behavior: Adds the image budget and rehosting service to the workflow import draft view, and checks upload permissions.
observations.posthog_connection: Creates an image budget and checks upload permissions before importing campaigns, suggesting the import will copy images and needs permission to do so.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F4.H1 is a complete implementation chunk. P1.F5.H1 and P1.F5.H2 are test-only hunks with no implementation changes, and P1.F5.H3 is a test-only import. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds Customer.io email image rehosting implementation: extracts Customer.io-hosted image URLs, checks budget and user permissions, downloads images with concurrency and deadline enforcement, and stores them in PostHog's media library, replacing original URLs in workflow HTML.
observations.posthog_connection: This could preserve email rendering and prevent account closure issues by rehosting Customer.io images into PostHog's media library, though the benefit depends on actual Customer.io account closure and user configuration. No score assigned.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test code. No implementation, configuration, or shared dependency changes are supplied. No score can be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds three new unit tests for Customer.io email image import, including checks for media-library copying, URL parameter preservation, and access-control enforcement.
observations.posthog_connection: These assertions verify that the Customer.io import workflow does not fetch images before the workflow is actually executed, and that it respects the configured media-library and access-control settings.
